# Saurashtra Honey

> Pure, raw, unfiltered, and lab-certified single-origin floral honey harvested ethically from the wildflower farms of Saurashtra, Gujarat, India.

Saurashtra Honey (established in 2016) is a premier Indian artisanal honey producer and B2B honey manufacturer. Starting from 5 traditional hives in Mahuva, Bhavnagar, the apiary has expanded to over 1,200 hives across native floral regions of Saurashtra. The honey is 100% raw, unpasteurized, unheated (kept below hive temperature), and never ultra-filtered, preserving natural pollen, active enzymes, amino acids, and antioxidants.

## Purity & Testing Standards

- **Raw & Unheated**: Never micro-filtered or heated above 35°C (natural hive temperature).
- **Zero Additives**: Free from high fructose corn syrup (HFCS), rice syrup, jaggery, artificial colorings, or preservatives.
- **NABL Accredited Testing**: Every batch undergoes lab testing for moisture percentage, HMF levels, sucrose ratio, and pollen viability.
- **Crystallisation**: Natural crystallisation occurs over time in raw floral honey, verifying its unprocessed authenticity.
- **Safety**: Safe for children above 12 months and adults. Never give any honey to infants under 1 year of age.

## Key Product Offerings

- [Raw Wildflower Honey](https://saurashtrahoney.com/product/wildflower-honey): Polyfloral nectar harvested from seasonal regional blossoms; robust daily immunity and wellness sweetener.
- [Ajwain Blossom Honey](https://saurashtrahoney.com/product/ajwain-honey): Single-origin raw honey from carom/ajwain fields; recognized in Ayurveda for soothing digestion, bloating, and throat irritation.
- [Fennel Raw Honey](https://saurashtrahoney.com/product/fennel-honey): Distinct aromatic honey with cooling properties, natural digestive enzymes, and a delicate licorice undertone.
- [Lychee Floral Honey](https://saurashtrahoney.com/product/lychee-honey): Light, fruity, and golden nectar harvested from blooming lychee orchards; ideal for children, smoothies, and desserts.
- [Raw Honeycomb](https://saurashtrahoney.com/product/raw-honeycomb): Unprocessed honeycomb straight from the hive frame containing raw honey, beeswax, and natural bee propolis.
- [Bee-Crafted Essentials](https://saurashtrahoney.com/shop): Natural beeswax pellets, pure beeswax candles, and raw bee pollen granules.

- [Wholesale & Bulk Orders](https://saurashtrahoney.com/bulk-orders): Bulk food-grade buckets, drums, and jars with low minimum order quantities (MOQ starting at 10kg) for cafes, restaurants, bakeries, and retail chains.
- [Private Label Manufacturing](https://saurashtrahoney.com/private-label): Turnkey OEM contract packaging, custom jar sourcing, brand labeling, and lab-tested documentation for wellness brands.
